question: AB and CD are two chords in a circle with centre O and AD is the diameter. When produced, AB and CD meet at the point P. If ∠DAP = 27°, ∠APD = 35°, then what is the measure (in degrees) of ∠DBC?
solution:
**Given:**

∠DAP = 27°, ∠APD = 35°

**Concept used:**

The angle subtended by the diameter at any point on the circumference is equal to 90°

Angles subtended by an arc in the same segment of the circle are equal.

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a398bd9bc2906e47e2a3a150a0f7cdb602ae4a7a0a4d579e3d26115fb020c9d7.png] 

In the given figure

∠DCA = ∠DBA = 90°

In ΔPCA

∠PAC = 180° - 90° - 35°

⇒ ∠PAC = 55°

Now,

∠DAC = 55° - 27°

⇒ ∠DAC = 28°

According to the concept,

∠DAC = ∠DBC = 28

**∴ The measure (in degrees) of ∠DBC is 28.**
